prompt:
Create ONE NEW full-body illustration of an adult red-haired female archer, using the ATTACHED Sdorica Sione illustration as the direct painting-style reference. Study its MAIN adult character: elegant designed color planes, selective fine linework, sculptural curved armor, quietly colored metal, intact material surfaces, purposeful variation in edges, and detail concentrated around the face and upper torso. Translate that specific visual language into a NEW archer character. This is a fresh design and painting, not a recolor of Sione. Do not copy her white bob, her pose, her weapons, the little chibi, lettering, pedestal or textured background.

CHARACTER AND COMPOSITION
A poised, athletic adult woman in her mid-twenties, warm ivory skin, expressive amber eyes, an attractive mature face with thoughtful, focused brows and understated lips. Vivid crimson hair tied in a long high ponytail with a small antique-gold clasp. The ponytail sweeps toward image left in a few unequal, tapered masses; its shape has an intentional main flow and subordinate locks.
She is in a powerful LOW grounded archery lunge: near leg reaches diagonally toward the bottom right with a naturally bent knee and firmly oriented boot; the other leg bends deeply beneath and behind her toward image left. Ribcage and pelvis turn coherently. Her bow-holding arm extends toward image right, the drawing elbow opens toward image left, and the drawing hand anchors the arrow nock beside her cheek. Clear foreshortening and weight, an assertive action silhouette, believable shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip and knee connections. The bow has a single correctly drawn string connecting its two tips through the pulled nock. One straight arrow correctly aligns with her sight and bow grip. Keep the whole figure, both feet and the whole bow inside the vertical frame, with breathing room.

NEW COSTUME: NOBLE ARCHER IN VIOLET AND COOL STEEL
Design the outfit specifically to read as a coherent whole. A fitted lightweight cold-gray steel cuirass with a broad continuous sculpted chest-to-waist surface, following the ribcage as one form instead of separate spherical cups. A small curved shoulder defense and a few substantial articulated plates at the waist. Large quiet metal surfaces; one integrated curved engraving near the collar/chest and a modest antique-gold clasp provide identity. Armor attachment is plausible, the shoulder and bowstring path remain free.
A rich royal-violet tailored garment connects to two broad, substantial split skirt panels with a deep plum lining. They sweep together behind the motion with a few weight-bearing folds. Bare upper arms and a tasteful glimpse of upper thigh keep the design agile. Deep plum-brown leather bracers, fitted gloves and practical long boots complete the lower silhouette. Gold is concentrated in the hair clasp, a chest ornament, belt closure and limited upper-body edging, rather than covering the legs or outlining every piece. Maintain a distinctive refined fantasy design with generous continuous surfaces and a small number of beautifully integrated details. No ordinary plain uniform, no white skirt lining, no floating ribbons, repeated spikes, patchwork straps or all-over decorative gold plate.
The bow has a graceful uninterrupted recurve silhouette, dark polished wood or subdued metal limbs and a finely worked grip. Keep its detail concentrated at the hand, with the outer limbs quieter.

THE PAINTING LANGUAGE IS THE PRIMARY GOAL
Closely follow the attached illustration's 2D form abstraction and carefully selected edges. Use connected midtone fields with a few designed light, turning and shadow shapes, subtle modulation inside broad planes, and very selective colored fine lines. Rounded anatomy and steel must still have volume. Preserve crisp edges at real overlapping joints and a few focal contours, soft transitions inside curved surfaces, and understated lines in quiet areas.
Steel is cool blue-gray with restrained lavender and warm reflected hues: broad intact curved surfaces, a few precise edge accents and contact shadows, with low internal visual noise. No mottled brown reflections, triangular facets, white glare shards or chrome polish. Cloth is an intact saturated violet material with only structurally necessary folds. Hair reads as rich red masses with shared light and shadow across locks, not shiny strips on every strand. Fine linework is subordinate to the color shapes. The interior surfaces are smooth and cleanly painted, not covered in paper grain, rough brush chips or a texture filter. Avoid 3D plastic rendering and generic glossy anime key art.

LIGHT AND COLOR HIERARCHY
Preserve vivid crimson and rich violet as strong, distinct color groups; the steel provides a quieter cool middle-value body, and small warm gold accents give refinement. Do not globally desaturate or wash everything in gray.
Use coherent broad diffuse illumination and a readable whole-figure value design. Her face, adjacent hair and upper shoulder establish the clearest focal contrast. Across torso, waist and legs, local colors remain stable through connected turning shadows. Warm skin is naturally modeled without making every exposed patch equally bright. Steel, cloth and leather share the lighting while retaining their material differences. Preserve body volume with broad midtones and clear overlaps. Leg armor, boots and lower bow must not become isolated bright jewels. Do not use dramatic spotlights, glows, rim-light outlines or a top-to-bottom black gradient to fake hierarchy.

OUTPUT
One fully finished, anatomically coherent character illustration, actual transparent alpha background with transparent gaps between limbs, hair and bow. Clean usable silhouette. No ground, scenery, halo, fog, grainy backdrop, pedestal, text, chibi, logo or comparison sheet. No checkerboard baked into the pixels.
